photos.file: Malabar whistling thrush (Myophonus horsfieldii) from anaimalai hills DSC 1742.jpg
photos.desc: Malabar whistling thrush (Myophonus horsfieldii) from anaimalai hills

Not often seen but always heard in the winter months. This bird is a renowned vocalist having a melodious, almost human-like, whistling call. Not surprisingly it is also called the "whistling schoolbo
Malabar whistling thrush, endemic to Western Ghats
